book.name: METIU
book.title: Yeisu Wasane Dodohobine Metiu wana Luluweli

content: Hawa Ngakngak Lihuine
Tab hu ehawa ngakngak-anid hene-bwaimiu, ilok Helak bwele taine i dehawa ngakngak-anmiu.
Helak wana hawa ngakngak heimiu bwele sohode lemi hawa ngakngak hene-bwaimiu heidiye. Luvi gane hu ginawi ge hu giyau hene-bwaimiu heidiye, iye te bwele hu howo.
Mwatan ge u hayaoyan hubwahi sunsunine havam he matane, age hubwahi bwabwaligane iye mwage huwo he matam taine u denunuwotu-yan?
Hebe hubwahi bwabwaligane mwage he matam, mwatan ge u liwo havam heine u nga, “Hubwahi sunsunine a ho tagan he matam?”
Toyoyokapis huwo! Dedei gen u ho tagan hubwahi bwabwaligane huwo he matam, iloke matam i wayae, ge habe bosowaim hubwahi sunsunine u ho tagan havam he matane.
Tab hu egiyau bigi gabgabubine hehewo heidiye, hebe si tiyepahavile ge si hayakmiu. Tab hu ebili lok lemi bak bobo haodiye, hebe si pedongedonge.
Hu Hawanun Helak heine Iloke I Giyau
Hu hawanun iloke Helak i giyau heimiu; hu luweni iloke hu paidi; hu pitipiti iloke gane i tate heimiu.
Kaiwane sega i hawanun bwele i howo, sega i luweni bwele i paidi, ge sega i pitipiti bwele gane i tate heine.
Mwatan hebe humiu hotiya natune i hawanun haga kaiwane, bwele u giyau pak?
O hebe i hawanun yalogi kaiwane, age bwele u giyau mwate?

Humiu, bwagane bobode ngakngakidiye, sauge hohoyowate bigi dodohobine hu egigiyau he-nanatumiu heidiye. Iloke ta lapu vetahe Tamamiu he bulubulu bigi dodohobine bwele i giyau heidiye hebwaden si hawanun heine.
Page gane nunuwamiu akum bobode si ginawi heimiu, hu ginawi sohode hedi heidiye. Moses wana Logugui ge profet wedi papalapu sohode ti yo.
Hiyede Ho-iwo Lihuine
Hu sesole he bagasetuk kikikipuine. Hel hana bagasetuk i magage ge hana hiyede i meyan, iyete bobode si hoyowate si dodoganan.
Age yawed hana bagasetuk i kikipu ge hana hiyede i puyowo, iyete hebwaden si paidi taine si dehoyowate.
Topapalapu Yoyokapis Lihuidiye
Hu yehemiu tab topapalapu yoyokapisidiye halingadiye hu elonge. Si luwom heimiu hedi lubluwob sohode sip, si tounuwo, age he yayaluwadiye sidiye sohode hehewo mamalekeidiye.
Wedi ginawi hinone hu paidi iloke hu lapuid. Siyo greip hinone taine ta edekibo he pipisare, age? Kapoi hinone taine ta edekibo he daudawou, age?
Sohode hedi, hubwahi dodohobine hinone hamnane i dohob, age hubwahi ngakngakine hinone hamnane i ngak.
Taine bosowaine hubwahi dodohobine hinone i dengak, ge taine bosowaine hubwahi ngakngakine hinone i dedohob.
Hubwahi bwabwaligane hebwaden hinodiye taine si dedohob si ik ge si yok tukanid he hiwo.
Sohode hedi, topapalapu yoyokapisidiye wedi ginawi hinone hu paidi iloke hu lapuid.
Taine tage bobode henebwaden si liwo heyau si nga, “Guyau, guyau” bwabwaligadiye bwele si setuk Helak he wana bagalogugui. Age sega i pabwasowo Tamau he bulubulu wana nuwotu, iye ege bwele i setuk.

Sauge yan mwaomwaoine i sevin, bobode hoyowate si liwo heyau si nga, “Guyau, guyau, hidam heine ha payoumate Helak wana lihu, hidam heine ha liwo iloke yayaluwo bikbikine si setagi, ge hidam heine ha ginawi pamali yauyawate.”
Bwele a liwo heidiye a nga, “Tan a delapumiu. Hu leke yokau, humiu ngak hana toginawi.”
Guwole hana Toginawi Ho-iwo
Iloke sega hebe lo lihulihu ga ya i longe ge i ginawi sohode, iye sohode tolomo gane wana nuwotu i sapu ge wana guwole i pamidi he pak pwatane.
Wesi i dau lahine, gungun i sali ge yangak i towo gaigaisi he guwole yake, agegene taine i demwabwin, kaiwane hana mwalu i miye he pak pwatane.
Sega hebe lo lihulihu ga ya i longe ge taine i deginawi sohode, iye sohode tolomo gane taine wana nuwotu i desapu ge wana guwole i pamidi he kelekele pwatane.
Wesi i dau lahine, gungun i sali ge yangak i towo gaigaisi he guwole yake, bwen i mwabwin, ge wana mwabwin butune i kai.
Saugeine Yeisu i gomwao lihulihu ya, bwen boda nuwadiye si hape wana papalapu kaiwane.
Taine i depapalapu sohode Logugui hana topapalapu-yan, i lihu vetahe ege bwaine ge wana gaisi.
